description: Preview a combined-book Hyperliquid hedge for one verified linear asset delta. Includes current portfolio limits and venue executability checks, never infers nonlinear hedges, and never signs, funds, bridges, or trades.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID. Omit for the active account.

allow_leverage.description: Permit a leveraged hedge candidate only after explicit review.

asset.description: Canonical asset symbol returned by get_portfolio_risk.

name: preview_portfolio_hedge
